2024_hf_comms_sharing.title: Workflow for Sharing of Healthcare Financing Comms Materials btw CPFB & MOH
2024_hf_comms_sharing.scope: Workflow and SLA for providing inputs, preparing, sharing, updating and disseminating Healthcare Financing (HF) communications materials between CPFB and MOH.

document_relationship.successor: Workflow for Preparation & Issuance of Media Materials for Healthcare Financing Schemes
document_relationship.note: The 2025 SOP was established after this 2024 SOP and CPFB's subsequent review. The two SOPs are related but distinct. For questions specifically about preparation and issuance of media materials such as press releases, media queries and interview requests, the 2025 SOP should also be consulted.

decision_framework.primary_question: Does the communications material require changes or updates on CPFB communications channels?

pathways.pathway: A - Comms materials requiring changes on CPFB comms channels
B - MOH-generated comms materials not requiring changes on CPFB comms channels

additional_questions: Is the material new or an editorial change to an existing asset?
Is the change factual only, or does it change the narrative?
Does the change arise from a policy change?
Is one HFG department involved or are multiple HFG departments involved?
Is CPFB mentioned in an MOH-generated material?
Will the material be hosted on a CPFB communications channel?
Is CPF-COM required to develop a new communications asset?
Does the activity involve a significant number of members (>=100,000) or a potentially negative impact on members?

aim: Establish internal workflows and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for preparation and sharing of Healthcare Financing comms materials at CPFB comms channels.
For materials requiring changes: provide inputs and prepare HF comms materials, and disseminate HF comms materials to CPFB frontliners.
For materials not requiring changes: disseminate HF comms materials from MOH to CPFB frontliners.
background: A post-mortem review on 2023 Participative Incentive Comms & Engagement activities was conducted and shared at the HFG meeting in Jan 2024.
Gaps identified included lack of timely updates of MOH's comms plan and lack of a proper SOP detailing steps and SLA for staff.
Since Jun 2024, HPD-SSE engaged HFG and COM to develop sustainable and operable workflows and SLAs.
Common understanding between MOH and CPFB on C&E matters was established at the CPF-MOH Comms Engagement meeting on 4 Sep 2024.

materials.note: Examples of comms materials are non-exhaustive.

clearance_rules.scope: All static contents and FAQs, external and internal, on the CPF and CSHL websites.
cpf_com_clearance_required: Revisions arising from policy changes, e.g. MediShield Life Review changes, subject to the stated exception.
Revisions to narratives, e.g. adding new information or changing the overall answer.
New narratives, e.g. new static contents and new FAQs.
cpf_com_clearance_not_required: Factual revisions arising from policy changes, e.g. replacement of dates or figures.
BAU changes with no changes to the narratives.
clearance_rules.footnote: The slide references an exception labelled 2a. Consult the original approved slide when determining whether that exception applies to a specific case.

general: Relevant CPF/MOH Points of Contact coordinate the workflow according to the type of outreach.
HFG provides healthcare-financing subject matter inputs, clarification and review.
CPF-COM develops or updates communications assets where required.
Relevant Ops/HFG teams identify affected materials, draft changes, obtain internal clearance and support dissemination.
CPF-SSE coordinates and consolidates inputs where multiple HFG departments are involved.

public_outreach.description: Comms efforts aimed at raising awareness and understanding among the public regarding various healthcare financing schemes, e.g. BAU Comms & Engagement activities.

cross_cutting_outreach.description: Public engagement efforts for healthcare initiatives involving changes to multiple features or benefits across healthcare financing schemes, e.g. overall consolidated changes for the MediShield Life Review.

policy_specific_outreach.description: Dissemination of information and updates related to specific healthcare policies.

project_specific_outreach.description: Comms efforts to inform about a particular healthcare financing project, its implementation and impact on individuals, e.g. Health Insurance Planner.

general_cpf_channel_change.name: Internal process for materials requiring changes on CPFB comms channels
steps: MOH-POC provides advance notice through updates in the CPFB and HFG COEs.
Determine whether inputs from CPF-HID/HCP are required.
If required, CPF-POC seeks inputs from CPF-HID/HCP.
CPF-POC collaborates with CPF-COM and/or MOH-POC to ensure affected materials at various channels are updated or to develop new comms materials.
MOH-POC provides inputs and/or reviews revised comms materials generated by CPFB.
If issues delay publicity launch or changes, CPF-POC collaborates with MOH-POC to resolve issues and adjust scope/timeline.
CPF-POC disseminates policy changes and updated comms materials, including holding lines and FAQs, to CPFB frontliners.
New publicity is launched and/or affected changes become effective.
CPF-POC collates feedback and provides it to MOH-POC for review and action.
general_cpf_channel_change.management_note: Inform CPFB management on publicity initiatives affecting a significant number of members (>=100,000) or assessed to have negative impact on members.

one_hfg_department.name: Projects involving only 1 HFG Department

If issues delay publicity launch or changes, CPF-HID collaborates with MOH-FP to resolve issues and adjust scope/timeline.

CPF-HID collates feedback and provides it to MOH-FP.
CPF-HID identifies affected comms materials, drafts new/changed materials, clears drafts internally with HOD and keeps CPF-SSE informed.
CPF-HID clears drafted materials with MOH-FP.
Determine whether revised materials need CPF-COM clearance.
If required, CPF-HID clears revised materials with CPF-COM and CPF-SLD via email and keeps CPF-SSE in the loop.
CPF-HID sends revised materials to MOH-FP for information and/or further clearance.
Where changes require sharing with more than one department or CPFB management/frontliners, coordinate with CPF-SSE and CPF-HCP.

multiple_hfg_departments.name: Internal process involving CPF-HID/HCP and/or cross-department HFG
steps: CPF-HID/HCP identifies affected comms materials under its purview and keeps CPF-SSE informed.
CPF-HID/HCP drafts new/changed comms materials.
CPF-HID/HCP clears drafted materials internally with HOD and keeps CPF-SSE informed.

CPF-SSE coordinates and consolidates affected comms materials from CPF-HID and CPF-HCP where required.
CPF-POC shares policy changes and comms plans with CPFB Management, CPF-HFG Management and relevant stakeholders.
Relevant HFG teams update revised comms materials at the affected platforms.
footnotes: For embargoed news, CPF-POC works with MOH-POC on what can be communicated internally. Early stages may only involve Section Heads and appointed project representatives.
Inform CPFB management on publicity initiatives affecting >=100,000 members or assessed to have negative impact on members.

cpfb_triggered_social_media.name: New social media comms materials where MOH involvement is not applicable
cpfb_triggered_social_media.applicability: MOH involvement is not required where MOH has given CPFB concurrence to produce social media comms materials without seeking MOH inputs, provided the messaging aligns with agreed HF key messages established with MOH for CPFB public education and outreach.
steps: CPF-SSE collaborates with CPF-COM to develop new comms materials.
CPF-SSE seeks inputs from CPF-HID/HCP teams.
Determine whether existing and/or new comms materials require actions.

existing_editorial_changes.name: Existing comms materials requiring editorial changes on CPFB comms channels
steps: HFG provides inputs and seeks clarification from MOH: 5 working days.
HFG identifies affected collaterals and drafts changes: 3 working days.
HFG seeks approval internally within HFG: 3 working days.
MOH seeks/provides approval: 10 working days.
COM/SLD clearance via email: 3 working days where applicable.
Relevant teams update the affected comms materials.
HFG disseminates information to CPFB frontliners: 10 working days prior to publicity launch.
exceptions: Editorial changes of greater complexity and/or larger volume require a longer SLA.
The 3-working-day COM/SLD clearance via email is noted as applicable only for the FAQ review and approving process.

new_comms_assets.name: New comms materials on CPFB comms channels requiring CPF-COM development
steps: HFG informs COM on required publicity and provides requirements: 5 working days.
CPF-COM develops the new comms material with HFG's inputs.
Where necessary, HFG disseminates information to CPFB frontliners: 10 working days prior to publicity launch.
new_comms_assets.resource_note: New and existing comms assets not in the prioritised list are subject to resource prioritisation. Comms plans and changes should be made known to CPF-COM as early as possible.

answering_rules: Use this SOP as the authoritative source for the 2024 workflow described here.
When a user provides a scenario, first classify the scenario before recommending a workflow.
Do not assume that every media-related question belongs to this SOP; distinguish comms-material sharing/update scenarios from the later 2025 media-material preparation and issuance SOP.
State the applicable pathway and explain why it applies.
Identify relevant roles/POCs and the required next action.
State the SLA only when supported by the source and identify the material category used to determine it.
If the scenario is ambiguous, ask targeted clarification questions rather than guessing.
Do not invent an SLA, role, clearance requirement or exception not present in the source.
For current or changed organisational processes, advise the user to verify against the latest endorsed SOP.

document.title: CPFB-MOH Workflow for Preparation & Issuance of Media Materials for Healthcare Financing Schemes
notes: source_slide refers to the original slide number in the 13-slide source deck. It is a citation/reference field only; the application does not need the original PDF or images to use it.

The source deck does not state a fixed numerical SLA. It states that the party responsible for preparing media materials must establish the required SLA/timeline with relevant parties before the workflow starts.

1.title: CPFB-MOH Workflow for Preparation & Issuance of Media Materials for Healthcare Financing Schemes

2.title: Recap and Aim
content: At the CPFB-MOH comms engagement meeting in Sep 2024, CPFB and MOH established the workflow and SLA for the preparation and sharing of Healthcare Financing (HF) materials between CPFB and MOH.
Existing workflows would be reviewed regularly between CPFB and MOH.
CPFB would also continuously review the need for additional workflows to address other scenarios if required.

Arising from CPFB's review, a set of framework and guiding principles was established on the rightful owner for developing comms materials and managing media queries regarding HF policy and/or ops-related announcements.
The workflow for the preparation and issuance of media materials was established.
2.footnote: There are already other SOPs in place, such as DRUMS SOP to handle mistruths for members who post on social media. This newly created SOP is to address all other scenarios arising under the respective buckets detailed in Slide 4.

3.title: Definition of Media Materials
media_materials: Interview requests (e.g. podcasts, stories on broadcast or print)
3.additional_scope: Includes but is not limited to any other forms of media engagement, communications, or content requests that may require official response or participation, e.g. Anticipated Media Queries, Media Factsheets, etc.

4.title: Guiding principles for identifying the rightful party to prepare comms materials and manage media queries on issues related to healthcare financing (HF)
4.decision_question: Is the matter operations-related, policy-related, or joint?

categories.label: Operations-related
categories.definition: Operational matters related to administration of healthcare schemes by CPFB.
categories.example: Feedback on a member's interactions with CPFB's service staff on healthcare matters.

categories.label: Policy-related
categories.definition: Policy announcements on financing schemes that concern CPFB.
categories.example: Announcements on scheme changes such as MediShield Life review.

categories.label: Joint
categories.definition: Products jointly developed by MOH and CPFB.
categories.example: CPFB & MOH jointly developed the Health Insurance Planner, a tool to assist members with healthcare financing planning.

5.title: Parties involved in the workflow takes on the listed overarching roles and responsibility

responsibilities.role: Responsible for initiating the drafting and issuance of media materials, and managing any sentiments relating to the issued media material.
Provide necessary inputs to comms and fact-check drafted materials.

responsibilities.party: MOH/CPFB Comms responsible for preparing the media materials
responsibilities.role: Accountable for establishing the understanding with relevant parties involved on the required SLA/timeline before commencement of the workflow.

6.title: Detailed roles and responsibilities between each party in CPFB & MOH

responsibilities: Initiate drafting of media materials where applicable.
Liaise with CPF-MPD to provide any inputs.
Touch base with MOH-HF for comments.
Provide any clarifications required to MOH-HF, CPF-MPD, CPFB HFG.
Clear media materials with MOH Senior Management.
Issue cleared media materials where applicable.
Staff level to provide comments to CPF-HID/HCP staff level when inputs are sought.
Provide any comments and clarifications required to MOH-CommsD.
Initiate drafting of media materials where applicable.
Triggers CPF-SSE and CPF-HID/HCP for any inputs.
Provides CPFB's inputs to MOH-CommsD.
Liaise with MOH-CommsD and CPFB HFG on any clarifications required.
Clears media materials with CPFB HODs and GDs, EXCO.
Informs relevant parties of cleared media content.
Issue cleared media materials where applicable.
Coordinates inputs provided by CPF-HID and CPF-HCP and provides CPFB HFG's inputs to MOH-CommsD and MOH-HF / CPF-MPD.
Liaise with CPF-MPD, CPFB HFG on any clarifications required.
Provides staff level inputs to CPF-SSE / CPF-MPD / MOH-CommsD and MOH-HF.
Liaise with MOH-HF, CPF-SSE on any comments and clarifications required.

6.footnote: Drafting and issuance of media materials depends on type of announcement or response (i.e. comms approach).

7.title: Proposed clearance process between CPFB & MOH for media materials
7.sla_note: The rightful party who prepares the media materials is accountable to establish an understanding with relevant parties involved on the required SLA/timeline before commencement of workflow.

workflows.title: Operation-related: CPFB prepares and manages media materials

steps.action: CPFB prepares and clears media materials up to EXCO.
CPFB sends cleared materials to relevant parties, including MOH-CommsD, for information.
CPFB issues media materials.

CPFB and MOH align on revisions if any.
MOH clears media materials with MOH Senior Management (up to PS/DSEs and Min) and keeps CPFB informed.
CPFB updates EXCO on changes, if any, and sends final materials to relevant parties for information.
MOH issues media material.

workflows.title: Joint: CPFB/MOH prepares and manages media materials

steps.action: CPFB/MOH prepares media materials with MOH/CPFB's inputs.
CPFB clears internally up to EXCO.
MOH clears internally up to GD level.
CPFB & MOH align on revisions if any.
MOH clears internally with MOH Senior Management (up to PS, DSEs and Min) and keeps CPFB informed.

steps.condition: If there are changes requiring CPFB EXCO update
steps.action: CPFB updates EXCO on changes, if any, and sends final materials to relevant parties for information.
CPFB/MOH issues media materials.

8.title: Detailed internal clearance process involving CPFB for operation-related media content

9.title: Workflow for media materials (operation-related) drafted by CPFB and involving HFG (either 1 or cross-departments)

steps.action: CPF-MPD drafts content and seeks CPF-HID and/or HCP staff level to provide inputs while keeping CPF-HPD-SSE in the loop.
CPF-HID and/or CPF-HCP staff level touches base with respective MOH-HF for comments if required.

CPF-HID and/or CPF-HCP staff level provides staff-level cleared inputs to CPF-MPD. CPF-HPD-SSE can provide additional comments when required. CPF-HPD-SSE will consolidate and provide if more than 1 department is involved.
CPF-MPD concurrently clears with HFG HOD(s), CPF-COM HOD, followed by GD(HF), GD(COM).
CPF-MPD clears with CPFB EXCO once CPF HODs and GDs have cleared.
Before issuance, CPF-MPD sends cleared content to: (1) MOM Min, SMSes, MOS, PS, DS for info; (2) Chairman and Board members for info; (3) CM for info; (4) MOH-CommsD and MOH-HF for info.
Concurrently notify CPF-HID and CPF-HCP teams on final cleared content.
Share the final cleared content and FAQs to CUG BP for dissemination to frontliners.
CPFB issues media content.

notes: CPF-HPD-SSE is to be kept in the loop for the whole process; same for CPF-COM-BP except for the yellow box.
CPF-MPD is to keep CPF-HID/HCP HODs and GD(HF) in the loop when clearing CPFB EXCO.
The relevant Section Head of the CPF-HID/HCP team is also to be kept in the clearance emails.

sla.rule: The rightful party preparing the media materials establishes the required SLA/timeline with relevant parties before commencement.

10.title: Detailed internal clearance process involving CPFB's inputs for policy-related media content
10.condition: Workflow only applies if CPFB's inputs are required.

11.title: Workflow for media materials (policy-related) drafted by MOH and requires CPFB's inputs involving HFG (either 1 or cross-departments)
11.condition: Applies when policy-related media materials are drafted by MOH and CPFB inputs are required.

steps.action: MOH-CommsD initiates drafting and alerts CPF-MPD. MOH-HF drafts the content. MOH-HF touches base with respective CPF-HID and/or HCP staff level, and MOH-CommsD seeks inputs.
CPFB HFG staff-level cleared inputs are provided to MOH-CommsD and MOH-HF.
MOH-CommsD proceeds clearance with MOH Directors (up to GD level) if no further changes. CPF-MPD concurrently clears with CPF-HID/HCP HOD, CPF-COM HOD, followed by GD(HF), GD(COM).
While MOH clears MOH Directors, CPF-MPD can proceed to clear with CPFB EXCO once CPF HODs and GDs have cleared.
CPF-MPD sends EXCO-cleared draft to MOH-CommsD. MOH-CommsD and CPF-MPD align on revisions if any.
MOH-CommsD proceeds to clear with MOH PS/DSEs and then Min.
CPF-MPD updates CPFB EXCO if there are further edits to earlier draft following MOH's clearance.
Before issuance, CPF-MPD sends cleared content to CM for info.
Concurrently notify CPF-HID and CPF-HCP teams on final cleared content.
Share the final cleared content and FAQs to CUG BP for dissemination to frontliners.
MOH issues media content.

notes: CPF-HPD-SSE is to be kept in the loop for the whole process; same for CPF-COM-BP.
CPF-MPD is to keep CPF-HID/HCP HODs and GD(HF) in the loop when clearing CPFB EXCO.
The Section Head of the relevant CPF-HID/HCP team is also to be kept in the clearance emails.

sla.rule: The rightful party preparing the media materials establishes the required SLA/timeline with relevant parties before commencement.

12.title: Detailed internal clearance process involving CPFB and MOH for joint policy or operation-related media content

13.title: Workflow for media materials (products jointly developed by MOH & CPFB) drafted by CPFB/MOH and involving HFG (either 1 or cross-departments)

steps.action: CPF-MPD initiates drafting and alerts MOH-CommsD. CPF-MPD drafts content and sends CPFB inputs to MOH-CommsD for inputs.
MOH-CommsD and MOH-HF staff level provides final comments to CPF-MPD.
MOH-CommsD initiates drafting and alerts CPF-MPD. MOH-HF drafts content. MOH-HF touches base with respective CPF-HID and/or HCP staff level, and MOH-CommsD seeks inputs.
CPFB HFG staff-level cleared inputs are provided to MOH-CommsD and MOH-HF.

common_steps_after_drafting.action: CPF-MPD informs MOH-CommsD if CPFB drafts content to proceed with clearance with MOH Directors if there are no further changes. Otherwise, MOH-CommsD directly proceeds with clearance. CPF-MPD concurrently clears with CPF-HID/HCP HOD, CPF-COM HOD, followed by GD(HF), GD(COM).
While MOH clears MOH Directors, CPF-MPD can proceed to clear with CPFB EXCO once CPF HODs and GDs have cleared.
CPF-MPD sends EXCO-cleared draft to MOH-CommsD. MOH-CommsD and CPF-MPD align on revisions if any.
MOH-CommsD proceeds to clear with MOH PS/DSEs and then Min.
CPF-MPD updates CPFB EXCO if there are further edits to earlier draft following MOH's clearance.
Before issuance, CPF-MPD sends cleared content to: (1) CM for info; (2) MOM Min, SMSes, MOS, PS, DS for info; (3) Chairman and Board members for info.
Concurrently notify CPF-HID and CPF-HCP teams on final cleared content.
Share the final cleared content and FAQs to CUG BP for dissemination to frontliners.

notes: CPF-HPD-SSE is to be kept in the loop for the whole process; same for CPF-COM-BP except for the yellow box.
CPF-MPD is to keep CPF-HID/HCP HODs and GD(HF) in the loop when clearing CPFB EXCO.
The Section Head of the relevant CPF-HID/HCP team is also to be kept in the clearance emails.

sla.rule: The rightful party preparing the media materials establishes the required SLA/timeline with relevant parties before commencement.

decision_rules.question: Is the matter operations-related?
decision_rules.if: It concerns operational matters related to administration of healthcare schemes by CPFB.
decision_rules.then: Use the operation-related pathway. CPFB is the rightful owner/preparer and issuer.

decision_rules.question: Is the matter policy-related?
decision_rules.if: It concerns policy announcements on financing schemes that concern CPFB.
decision_rules.then: Use the policy-related pathway. MOH is the rightful owner/preparer and issuer.

decision_rules.question: Is the matter jointly developed?
decision_rules.if: It concerns a product or material jointly developed by MOH and CPFB.
decision_rules.then: Use the joint pathway. CPFB and MOH jointly prepare/manage and issue the material.

decision_rules.question: Does the policy-related workflow involving CPFB apply?
decision_rules.if: CPFB's inputs are required for policy-related media content drafted by MOH.
decision_rules.then: Use the detailed policy-related workflow in Slide 11.

decision_rules.question: Who establishes the SLA/timeline?
decision_rules.if: A party is responsible for preparing the media materials.
decision_rules.then: That responsible party establishes the required SLA/timeline with relevant parties before the workflow begins.

decision_rules.question: Does this SOP cover every social-media-related case?
decision_rules.if: The scenario is specifically a member mistruth on social media.
decision_rules.then: Check the existing DRUMS SOP rather than automatically applying this workflow.

sla.rule: The party responsible for preparing the media materials is accountable for establishing an understanding with relevant parties on the required SLA/timeline before commencement of the workflow.
sla.bot_instruction: Never invent a numerical SLA. If asked for an SLA duration, state that the source SOP does not specify a fixed numerical duration and directs the responsible party to establish the required SLA/timeline with relevant parties before the workflow begins.

responsibilities: Initiate drafting of media materials where applicable.
Liaise with CPF-MPD for inputs.
Touch base with MOH-HF for comments.
Provide clarifications required to MOH-HF, CPF-MPD and CPFB HFG.
Clear media materials with MOH Senior Management.
Issue cleared media materials where applicable.
Provide staff-level comments to CPF-HID/HCP staff level when inputs are sought.
Provide comments and clarifications required to MOH-CommsD.
Initiate drafting of media materials where applicable.
Trigger CPF-SSE and CPF-HID/HCP for inputs.
Provide CPFB inputs to MOH-CommsD.
Liaise with MOH-CommsD and CPFB HFG on clarifications.
Clear media materials with CPFB HODs, GDs and EXCO.
Inform relevant parties of cleared media content.
Issue cleared media materials where applicable.
Coordinate inputs provided by CPF-HID and CPF-HCP.
Provide CPFB HFG inputs to MOH-CommsD and MOH-HF / CPF-MPD.
Liaise with CPF-MPD and CPFB HFG on clarifications.
Provide staff-level inputs to CPF-SSE / CPF-MPD / MOH-CommsD and MOH-HF.
Liaise with MOH-HF and CPF-SSE on comments and clarifications.

exceptions_and_notes.description: Existing SOPs remain applicable to scenarios already covered by them. The source deck specifically gives DRUMS SOP as an example for handling mistruths involving members who post on social media.
The detailed policy-related workflow only applies when CPFB inputs are required.
Drafting and issuance depends on the type of announcement or response, i.e. the communications approach.
For cross-department HFG matters, CPF-HPD-SSE consolidates inputs where more than one department is involved.
CPF-HPD-SSE is to be kept in the loop throughout the relevant process.
CPF-MPD should keep CPF-HID/HCP HODs and GD(HF) in the loop when clearing CPFB EXCO.
The relevant Section Head of the CPF-HID/HCP team should be kept in the clearance emails.

required_answer_structure: Explain briefly why the pathway applies.
List the relevant workflow steps in sequence.
Identify relevant stakeholders and clearance points.
State the SLA/timeline rule. Do not invent a numerical SLA.
Cite the relevant source slide number(s).
grounding_rules: Use only information contained in this JSON as the approved SOP source.
Do not invent missing SLA durations.
Do not infer an owner where the source does not provide one.
If the scenario is ambiguous between operations-related, policy-related and joint, ask a targeted clarification or explain the possible pathways.
If a scenario appears to fall under an existing SOP outside this deck, flag that rather than forcing it into one of the three pathways.
When the answer depends on whether CPFB provides inputs, explicitly state that condition.
